sources: Flare 2.0 热身 v2 / 练后三档 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后：婴儿式侧伸）

purpose.zh: 拉长背部侧面和腋下，练完支撑动作后放松后背
purpose.en: Lengthens the side of your back and under the arm after support training.

text.zh: 臀坐脚跟，双手走到一侧，拉长另一边
text.en: Hips on heels, hands to one side, lengthen the other side

text.zh: 跪坐，臀部坐在脚跟上，上身趴下，双臂往前伸长。
text.en: Kneel, sit your hips on your heels, fold forward and reach your arms long.

text.zh: 双手一前一后走到一侧，对侧的背和腋下有拉长的感觉。
text.en: Walk both hands over to one side until the opposite side of your back stretches.

text.zh: 臀部一直坐在脚跟上，不跟着手走。
text.en: Keep your hips on your heels; they do not follow the hands.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the hips off the heels.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不舒服可以在膝下垫毛巾
cautions.en: Put a towel under your knees if they feel uncomfortable.

flare2.camera: 俯视偏前（看得到双手侧移和背部侧弯）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：静态保持，左右各一次；草稿每侧 30 秒 1 组（秒数待定）
flare2.note: Animation r2: 16 s loop = hands walk to the body left (stretches the right side) 1-6.5 s, centre, then to the right 8-13.5 s; hips stay on the heels.

set.zh: 臀部坐在脚跟上，双手放到一侧
set.en: Hips on heels, both hands to one side

set.zh: 另一边的背和腋下拉长就够了
set.en: Feel the other side of your back lengthen

set.zh: 臀部别跟着手走，喘气放松
set.en: Hips stay on heels, keep breathing

sides.note: 双手先走到身体左侧（拉右侧背），再走右侧；换边准备 10 秒（App 未接入）
